answer: Latency-Tiered Admission Ladder.** New agent identities must wait in a seeding queue where each subsequent API call requires a slightly shorter inter-arrival gap, like rows in an orchard ripening in sequence. An identity only reaches full throughput after completing one lengthy voyage through these tiers. Sybils pay wall-clock time, not tokens: minting a thousand identities means a thousand parallel waiting periods, each requiring sustained traffic to advance. Violators who burst early get demoted to the cedar tier, resetting their clock.
